articleTitle: How to Plan for Aging Without Kids (and With a Disabled Dependent)
imageHeadline: Aging Without Kids? Plan Your Support Network Now
imageSubtext: See the full roadmap for caregivers on the site
pinTitle: how to plan for aging without children when you're a caregiver
pinDescription: If you're caring for a disabled dependent and don't have kids of your own, planning for aging requires a different approach. Learn how to build a sustainable support network, navigate legal planning for two people, and create a care plan that works when family isn't the answer. Get the complete step-by-step guide.
